draft.emotion: frowning and tight-lipped, feeling slighted and irritated
notes: 生气 is used both as an adjective ('angry') and as a separable verb-object word ('to get angry'): 他很生气 (he is very angry), 别生我的气 (don't be angry with me).
You can also use 跟 or 对 to mark who the anger is directed at: 他跟/对我生气了。
